Laravel JSON API backend for the Magic Starter Flutter app (`magic_starter`), published as `anilcancakir/magic-starter-laravel`, PHP namespace `AnilcanCakir\MagicStarter\`. Code, comments, docs and commits are British English.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `composer test` | PHPUnit through Orchestra Testbench (about three minutes) |
| `composer lint` | Pint check, no changes; `composer lint:fix` applies them |
| `composer analyse` | PHPStan level 6 with Larastan (`--memory-limit=1G`) |
| `python3 tool/check-docs.py` | Offline gate for `doc/` and `README.md` |

## Architecture

```
src/
├── MagicStarter.php                 # Static model resolution registry (never hardcode model classes)
├── MagicStarterServiceProvider.php  # Contract binding, route registration, rate limiters, schedules
├── Features.php                     # Feature flags that gate routes, logic and resources
├── Actions/                         # Business logic (implements Contracts/)
├── Contracts/                       # Action interfaces; hosts override them with a container binding
├── Http/                            # Thin controllers, feature-aware requests, conditional resources
├── Models/ Traits/ Enums/           # Eloquent models (ConditionallyUsesUuids), user mixins, value enums
├── Filament/                        # Optional admin panel; resources follow the enabled features
├── Console/ Jobs/ Notifications/    # Install and billing commands, queued work, OneSignal channel
├── Support/ Audit/ Social/          # MigrationHelper, session agent, audit recorder, sign-in verification
└── routes/api.php                   # Feature-gated, rate-limited api/v1 routes
config/magic-starter.php             # Feature toggles, model classes, auth identity, UUID switch
database/migrations/                 # Published into the host app by the installer
resources/boost/                     # Laravel Boost skill and guidelines shipped to host apps
stubs/                               # Files the installer copies into the host app
doc/  tool/check-docs.py  llms.txt  # User docs for the docs site, their offline gate, agent entry point
```

The routes in `src/routes/api.php`, the social callbacks and the push external-id prefix are the contract with `magic_starter`: change one side, keep the other in sync.

## Code Style

- Controllers inject interfaces from `Contracts/`; a host swaps one with `$this->app->bind(CreatesUsers::class, CustomCreateUser::class)`
- Resolve models through `MagicStarter::userModel()`, `::teamModel()` and friends, never `App\Models\*` directly
- Check `Features::hasTeamFeatures()` or `Features::enabled()` before feature-specific logic; resources use `$this->when(Features::has*(), ...)`
- UUID or integer keys: `MigrationHelper::primaryKey($table)` in migrations, `ConditionallyUsesUuids` on models; never `$table->id()`
- Phone numbers are E.164 only, validated with the `E164Phone` rule

## Post-Change Checklist

A change is not done while one of these is stale:

1. `CHANGELOG.md`: an entry under `[Unreleased]` (the `Changelog` check fails a code PR without one)
2. `README.md`, `llms.txt` and the `doc/` pages when features, config keys or behaviour change; run `python3 tool/check-docs.py`
3. The Boost skill in `resources/boost/skills/magic-starter-development/` and `resources/boost/guidelines/core.blade.php`; the skill `version:` moves with the release
4. This file's architecture tree when directories move
5. The Flutter client `magic_starter` when an `api/v1` shape changes

## Development Flow (TDD)

Write the failing test first, make it pass with the least code, then refactor with the suite green. Run `composer test`, `composer lint` and `composer analyse` before opening a PR.

## Testing

- Base class `AnilcanCakir\MagicStarter\Tests\TestCase` (Orchestra Testbench); fixtures in `tests/Fixtures/` (`ConcreteUser`, `ConcreteTeam`, `ConcreteTeamUser`, `ConcreteTeamInvitation`)
- CI runs PHP 8.2 to 8.4 on Laravel 12, plus legs for Filament, a run without the optional packages and PostgreSQL

## Key Gotchas

- Guest users may have a null email and a null password: guard with null checks
- Call `method_exists()` before optional trait methods on the user model
- The package disables Sanctum's migrations; its `PersonalAccessToken` carries the device info columns
- The password reset URL is customised in the service provider's `boot()`; do not override it separately
- Model auto-resolution tries `App\Models\*` first through `class_exists()`, so a stale Composer classmap can pick the wrong class
- `phpstan.neon` holds targeted ignores for the trait and dynamic-model patterns; fix the root cause instead of adding suppressions
- Team membership is a pivot model: use `->using(MagicStarter::membershipModel())`

## Release

Run `/release` (`.claude/commands/release.md`). The stamps are the `[Unreleased]` promotion in `CHANGELOG.md` and the skill `version:`; the tag is the bare version (`1.0.1`, no `v`) on the merge commit. A failed `Validate` published nothing but a re-run builds the original commit, so fix it on a pull request and, with the owner's approval, delete the tag and tag the new merge commit. Use "Re-run failed jobs", never "Re-run all jobs", only when `publish` succeeded and `GitHub Release` failed. A version Packagist accepted is final.

## CI

- `ci.yml`: push and PR on `master`; the test, Filament, no-optional, PostgreSQL, Pint and PHPStan jobs feed the aggregator job `Lint & Test`
- `changelog.yml`: a PR that changes `src/`, `config/`, `database/`, `resources/`, `stubs/`, `lang/` or `composer.json` must change `CHANGELOG.md`; Dependabot, `release:` PRs and the `skip-changelog` label are exempt
- `docs-link-check.yml`: `Internal Links` on every PR (`tool/check-docs.py` and an offline lychee pass), `External Links` on Mondays
- `publish.yml`: bare tag on master, then `Validate` (stamps, tests, Pint, PHPStan, changelog section), `publish` (Packagist update), `GitHub Release`
